findings.title: HTTPS transport
findings.description: Sensitive educational-platform traffic should be protected with HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Serve the platform over HTTPS and redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS.

findings.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.description: HSTS instructs browsers to use HTTPS for future requests.
findings.recommendation: Configure Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age after HTTPS is stable.

findings.title: TLS certificate validity window
findings.description: Certificates close to expiry can interrupt secure access and create operational risk.
findings.evidence: TLS certificate not applicable to an HTTP target
findings.recommendation: Renew certificates before expiry and automate renewal where possible.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: CSP reduces the impact of script injection by restricting allowed content sources.
findings.recommendation: Define and test a restrictive Content-Security-Policy appropriate for the application.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: The nosniff directive prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing responses.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection
findings.recommendation: Use CSP frame-ancestors and/or X-Frame-Options where appropriate.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Referrer-Policy limits information disclosed in outbound Referer headers.
findings.recommendation: Set a Referrer-Policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter where suitable.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Permissions-Policy restricts access to selected browser capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Define a Permissions-Policy that disables unused browser features.

findings.title: Secure cookie attribute
findings.description: Secure prevents cookies from being sent over unencrypted HTTP.
findings.evidence: Assessed cookies: MoodleSession; Secure present on all: True
findings.recommendation: Mark authentication/session cookies as Secure when HTTPS is used.

findings.title: HttpOnly cookie attribute
findings.description: HttpOnly reduces access to session cookies from client-side scripts.
findings.evidence: Assessed cookies: MoodleSession; HttpOnly present on all: True

findings.title: SameSite cookie attribute
findings.description: SameSite can reduce cross-site request risks for session cookies.
findings.evidence: Assessed cookies: MoodleSession; SameSite present on all: True
findings.recommendation: Set an appropriate SameSite value (Lax or Strict unless cross-site use is required).

findings.title: Server version disclosure
findings.description: Detailed server banners can expose implementation and version information.
findings.recommendation: Suppress detailed product/version banners where operationally feasible.

findings.title: X-Powered-By disclosure
findings.description: X-Powered-By may disclose framework or runtime information.
findings.recommendation: Remove X-Powered-By headers unless there is a clear operational need.

findings.title: CORS wildcard exposure
findings.description: An unrestricted Access-Control-Allow-Origin can expose resources to cross-origin reads.
findings.evidence: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header observed for the assessment Origin
findings.recommendation: Allow only trusted origins for resources that require cross-origin access.
